description: This file defines the class EmailTemplateUtils, which manages email templates within the vtiger CRM system. It handles parsing template descriptions to identify variables, retrieves module data via web services, processes the template by substituting variables with actual data from the database, and provides the processed email description.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: A class representing an email template in vtiger CRM, providing methods to parse, process, and retrieve the customized email content based on module data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an EmailTemplate instance with module name, description, record ID, and user.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets and parses the description to identify template variables associated with the module.

methods.name: getTemplateVariableListForModule
methods.description: Retrieves the list of template variables for the specified module.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Retrieves data from the database and replaces template variables in the description with actual data.

methods.name: getProcessedDescription
methods.description: Returns the processed description, processing it if it hasn't been processed yet.
